items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: he was already on the road with Les Brown or Tommy Dorsey

ctx.x: We’re not really sure except of course I idolized my brother when I was growing up you know, he was already on the road with Les Brown or Tommy Dorsey and he’s ten or eleven years older, so as I say I idolized him when I was growing up because he was playing these great clarinet solos and everything.
That’s good. A lot of times siblings don’t exactly get along too well.
